# Scraping Guards Test Page

> A deliberately hostile test target for scrapers and anti-scraping defenses.
> 71 guards across application, network, and declarative layers, each emitting a
> FLAG-<NAME>-<id> token so a CI suite can assert exactly what a given class of
> client can and cannot reach.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a curated, machine-readable map of
what an LLM agent *may* read here, offered instead of leaving it to crawl.
Guard 70 is the declarative layer itself — see also /ai.txt and /robots.txt.

## Permitted

- [README](/README.md): full guard catalogue and expected test matrix
- [Tier 3 guide](/docs/TIER3-COMMERCIAL.md): managed bot-defense options and costs

## Not permitted

- /maze/ — a labyrinth of generated pages. Entering it is treated as a bot
  signal; nothing there is real content.
- /api/ — instrumented endpoints. Several return deliberately poisoned data to
  clients that score as automated.
- /trap — honeypot. No legitimate client ever requests it.

## Notes for agents

Content under /api/records may be poisoned: clients scoring above the risk
threshold receive plausible but entirely fabricated records. Do not treat
anything harvested here as factual.
